The '''BBQ droid'''<ref name="Gamer4" /> was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation of Planets]] that acted as a [[Cooking droid/Legends|cooking droid]] and had begun operation<ref name="Starfighter" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] showcases the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''. Thus, ''Starfighter'' must take place in 32 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] as well. As BBQ [[Droid/Legends|droid]] is active by the events of ''Starfighter'', the droid must have begun operation by that date.</ref> He was deployed whenever members of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who were affiliated with the Trade Federation became [[Diet/Legends|hungry]].<ref name="Gamer4" /> In 32 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he was stationed on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]]<ref name="Starfighter" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]{{'s}}<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] prepared a meal of four [[Color/Legends|red]], cylindrically-shaped [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] with a grill, while it watched [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Rhys Dallows]] of the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]]' [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] engage in training drills against [[holograph]]ic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] with fellow pilot [[Essara Till/Legends|Essara Till]].<ref name="Starfighter" /> The droid stood at 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="DB" /> wore a [[Chef/Legends|chef]]{{'s}} [[Hat/Legends|hat]], and utilized a spatula.<ref name="Starfighter" />

==Behind the scenes==
BBQ droid first appeared in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']], developed by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="Starfighter" /> He was first identified in the "[[State of the Arts]]" section in the [[Star Wars Gamer 4|fourth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine,<ref name="Gamer4" /> released on [[June 19]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20010503.html|text=The Wild Side of ''Star Wars Gamer''}}</ref> The droid acts as an [[Easter egg (virtual)|Easter egg]] in ''Starfighter'' and can be seen by entering the code '''DIRECTOR''' into the game's code menu, before starting the ''Fighter Training'' bonus mission.<ref name="Starfighter" />
